Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. I’m Tessa on the SDR team — I’ll do a quick pre-demo check so the engineers we bring are the right fit. Two quick asks before we lock a demo slot: a short traffic snapshot and a target timeline. Could you reply with the bullet answers below? I attached a tiny usage-template.csv that helps if you want to paste numbers.

1) Primary use case (one line):
2) Typical requests/day and average tokens per request (or a quick % split across write vs. embed vs. chat):
3) Peak concurrent requests or RPS you’ve seen / expect at launch:
4) Latency SLOs (p95 p50) and whether you need strict sub-100ms service for part of the workload:
5) Pilot timeline — earliest start for a pilot and target production date:
6) Security must-haves (SOC 2, VPC/private deployment, data residency / encryption / contract terms):
7) Any existing logins/SSO or procurement constraints we should know now:

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR (Inbound) | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@pixelcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Mehta <priya@pixelcart.com>, PixelCart Ops <ops@pixelcart.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Prep: Inbound demo — product fit, throughput & timeline

Thanks Tessa — quick answers below (happy to expand in the call):

1) Primary use case: assist search ranking + conversational support triage (re-ranking + short generative responses).
2) Typical traffic: ~200,000 model calls/day right now; average tokens per generation ~55 (most responses are short). We also use embeddings for search re-ranking (~20k embedding calls/day).
3) Peak: during promotions we’ve seen spikes up to ~45 RPS; steady-state closer to 8–12 RPS.
4) Latency: p95 target ~300ms for user-facing re-rank; for quick chat answers p95 ~600ms is ok. We don’t need sub-100ms.
5) Timeline: pilot — start mid-June, production roll by Aug (Q3).
6) Security: SOC 2 required; VPC option preferred but not mandatory for pilot. Data residency: US only.
7) Procurement: small pilot POC contract OK (PO required for production). We use Okta SSO.

I attached a short ops snapshot (CSV) with sample traffic from last month. Let us know if you need more granularity.

— Sanjay
Head of Platform | PixelCart
sanjay@pixelcart.com

Hi Sanjay — great context, thanks. A couple quick notes and a calendar ask so we can lock engineering time:

- For the traffic profile you described (200k calls/day, 55 tokens/gen, peaks ~45 RPS), I’d recommend we prepare a pilot configuration targeting sustained 50 RPS with burst to 80 RPS and KV/prefix caching enabled for common queries. That keeps p95 well under your targets for re-rank workloads.
- Pilot proposal: 2-week pilot (load-tested sandbox + SSO test) -> production ramp. We’ll surface estimated token burn and a small PO-friendly pricing line in the follow-up.
- Security: SOC 2 + VPC is doable; for pilot we can do hosted with private network peering if you want to avoid an on-prem setup immediately.

Please pick one of these slots (we’ll reserve engineering time once you confirm). All times in PT (we noticed you use ET):
1) Tue, 15 Jun — 10:00–10:30 PT (Engineer: L1 + Solutions)
2) Wed, 16 Jun — 16:30–17:00 PT (Engineer: L2 + Infra)
3) Thu, 17 Jun — 08:30–09:00 PT (Engineer: L1 + Security)

Or share times that work in ET and we’ll convert. Quick calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/book/ben/pc-197 (one-click to confirm).

Related hubspot: https://redwood.app/hubspot/PC-197

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
